allDecisions.proposal: Repo-wide: only CvPreviewModal passes containerClassName="h-[92vh] w-[96vw] max-w-[96vw]". proposedSlots.proposal: Repo-wide: only MiniCartDrawer passes dialogClassName/footerClassName. dialogClassName="sm:max-w-md" is a real dialog width (DrawerShell has no size prop; DrawerDialog only owns gap-3). footerClassName forces a vertical stacked footer (flex-col! items-stretch! justify-start! gap-3! border-t) because HeroUI Drawer.Footer hard-codes flex-row justify-end. Honest API: dialogWidth="md" (maps to sm:max-w-md inside DrawerShell) + footerVariant="stacked" (column stretch + top border, owned by shell). Do NOT remove props while MiniCart depends on them. Apply when both named props land on src+Storybook twins and MiniCart migrates in the same change.

proof.whyNotSafeRemoval: MiniCart is a live consumer; removal would drop max-width and stacked footer layout.
proof.whyNotSafeMigration: No existing named prop/token on DrawerShell or Drawer atom covers max-w-md or stacked footer; inventing className escapes is forbidden.

proposedSlots.proposal: Repo-wide: only CvPreviewModal passes containerClassName="h-[92vh] w-[96vw] max-w-[96vw]". HeroUI ModalContainer size tokens are xs|sm|md|lg|cover|full. cover = full screen with 16px/40px margins; full = 100dvh edge-to-edge no radius. Neither equals 92vh×96vw. Honest API: viewportFit="near-fullscreen" (or size="preview") owned by ModalShell with those exact classes baked in — not size="cover"/"full". Pair with PDFView height ownership (see PDFView-heightClassName). Manifest lint row marked safe-consumer-migration is a classifier false positive (generic containerClassName message missed the h-[92vh] consumer); treat as new-named-slot-required.

notEquivalent.full: 100dvh, no margins/radius — not 92vh×96vw with modal chrome

proposedSlots.proposal: heightClassName remains until canon defines a closed viewer-height scale. Observed values: default h-[560px]; stories h-[200|320|400|420px]; CvPreview h-[84vh]. Canon (styling-tailwind.md §1) allows arbitrary [Npx] for media/canvas, but no named height enum exists — do NOT invent sm/md/lg tokens. Honest future API once product locks sizes: heightPx:number (canvas) + heightFit:"modal-body" → h-[84vh] owned by PDFView. Preserve every current pixel/vh exactly; Storybook/src/block twins must stay aligned. Block PDFView also carries vendor/identity/cn holds — out of scope for per-part apply.

proof.whyNotSafeRemoval: Multiple real consumers depend on distinct heights; CvPreview 84vh is not the 560px default.

proposedSlots.proposal: Keep contentClassName. External SurfaceCard consumers need distinct body chrome: ContinueCard* relative flex-col gap-3 overflow-hidden (stacking-layout owns ContinueCard — do not edit those files here); LeagueCard/LeaderboardListCard flex-col gap-3; TalentMarketplace/LearnLoopScroll add p-4 + justify; PersonalProject* use grid cols; PressableGroup internally injects TILE_CHROME. Coordinate with stacking-layout: they migrate ContinueCard once SurfaceCard exposes bodyVariant; this worker does not steal ContinueCard files.
